checks.name: flight study corridor

checks.name: support-post consolidation
checks.evidence: The adjacent support pairs in the refreshed exports read as single structural posts with shared cable endpoints; no doubled post pair is visibly competing for the same cable junction.

checks.name: roof and wall joins
checks.evidence: The visible tower and low-building roofs in street-start.png, street-center.png and street-end.png meet their wall bodies cleanly without detached plates, open gaps or floating eave layers.

checks.name: duplicate or ghost whole scene
checks.evidence: The four current exports show one continuous assembled street and no duplicated panorama, ghost facade or second full-scene image layer. Faint distant silhouettes remain depth treatment rather than a duplicate scene.

checks.name: foreground material integration and variation
checks.evidence: The fog-tinted roofed stall copies blend with the cool depth treatment, while stall dimensions and cable-lamp spacing vary across the three desktop windows and the phone view. No blocking pasted-material edge or uniform foreground cadence remains visible.

checks.name: art-candidate structural/presentation gate
checks.evidence: No blocking structural or presentation defect is visible in the frozen exports for the requested four findings. The current files are suitable for art-candidate delivery within this static-preview scope.

limitations: This is a static preview review only. It does not verify runtime collision geometry, player readability during motion, or a live horizontal pan.
The subdued lower foreground remains a deliberate art treatment; natural runtime contrast should be checked separately.
This report does not sign off an 80–90% similarity score and does not treat the supplied panorama as reusable composition input.
The report is bound to the four hashes recorded in scope; later regeneration requires a new final visual check.
